"""P10: the supplier gives its final offer in round 1 and always picks the 56-day sheet (EUR 33.6k of lateness
for us, = EUR 0.72 a unit). Offer only the 42-day sheet; same claims as the agent (should-cost accepted, forecast).
Break-even vs today's 31.70/56 d: a 42-day price up to 32.41."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, their_sheet

CASE = "case:P10"


def move(st):
    if st["round"] > 1:
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    body = ("Dear Monika,\n\nI understand that very high capacity utilisation means you must prioritise customers with "
            "firm, long-term commitments.\n\n"
            "Our bottom-up estimate of your unit cost for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 (cost:340010), before any margin.\n"
            "Our volume forecast for part:340010 changed by +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We make our full requirement a "
            "firm annual commitment: 23,400 pcs a year for 36 months.\n\n"
            "Our production plan needs a 42-day lead time. On that basis we can confirm EUR 27.37 per unit, 42-day lead "
            "time, 23,400 pcs a year, 36 months.\n\nBest regards,\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
    return msg("Mechanical seal 24 mm - firm 36-month commitment", body,
               [{"unit_price": 27.37, "volume_per_year": 23400, "contract_months": 36, "lead_time_days": 42}])

case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm - firm 36-month commitment
message.body:
Dear Monika,

I understand that very high capacity utilisation means you must prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments.

Our bottom-up estimate of your unit cost for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 (cost:340010), before any margin.
Our volume forecast for part:340010 changed by +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We make our full requirement a firm annual commitment: 23,400 pcs a year for 36 months.

Our production plan needs a 42-day lead time. On that basis we can confirm EUR 27.37 per unit, 42-day lead time, 23,400 pcs a year, 36 months.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm - firm 36-month commitment
response.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Your cost estimates do not reflect the realities of our specialized production. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We acknowledge the volume of 23,400 pieces and the 36-month term, but our high capacity utilization precludes a 42-day lead time. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

We state a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

As an alternative, we propose EUR 31.90 per unit, strictly maintaining a 54-day lead time with a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
